title: Scaffold & challenge harness

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories (created by their own challenge tasks)

acceptance_criteria: package.json pins Next.js 16 to an exact version (no caret/tilde range) and declares scripts for dev, build, start, lint, and typecheck; React, TypeScript, and Tailwind are present as dependencies.

next.config.ts is the single canonical config and enables Cache Components (cacheComponents / 'use cache' support) per the LOCKED PROJECT CONFIG; `next build` exits 0 and produces a .next/ directory against the pinned version (QA: Repo builds successfully).
`tsc --noEmit` exits 0 with zero errors and `npm run lint` exits 0 with zero errors against the scaffold (QA: TypeScript typecheck passes / ESLint passes).

lib/registry.ts exports a discovery helper that globs app/(challenges)/*/_meta/challenge.config.ts and app/page.tsx renders the auto-discovered challenge index from it — no hand-maintained nav list exists anywhere.

HARNESS.md documents the per-challenge folder convention (live routes under app/(challenges)/cNN-slug/**, metadata under _meta/ with spec.md + defend-it.md + verification.md + challenge.config.ts, local _components/_lib/_tests, reference solution under solutions/cNN-slug/**) and docs/decision-log.md contains a rendering-strategy decision-log skeleton with at least one filled example row.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
